title: New patient has no inherited appointments or medications
steps: Register a synthetic patient as fixture
expected: Both appointment groups and current medications are empty; seeded patient records do not leak into the new profile.

title: Filter appointment slots by provider and visit type
steps: Select Dr. Maya Rowan and Primary Care
expected: Every returned slot matches both selected filters.

title: An unavailable appointment date has a clear empty state
expected: No matching appointments is shown and no Book button remains.

title: Dismiss booking confirmation without creating a booking
expected: Scheduling page and selected slot remain; no booking details are opened.

title: Book a slot and preserve the new appointment after refresh
expected: Scheduled status and appointment details remain after refresh.

title: Save a pre-visit questionnaire and reload it
expected: Saved questionnaire text remains in appointment details.

title: Submit a patient reschedule request without changing the booking time
expected: The request is saved and the appointment remains Scheduled pending staff action.

title: Staff reschedules the requested booking and patient sees replacement
steps: Staff selects the test patient and booking
Choose another slot and confirm reschedule
Patient opens replacement and previous booking
expected: New appointment is Scheduled; previous appointment is Cancelled with reschedule reason.

title: Cancel the replacement booking and preserve its reason
expected: Cancelled status and the supplied reason persist.

title: Complete simulated eCheck-In on a new booking
expected: Checked In status persists and check-in action is no longer available.

title: Empty message submission is blocked by required fields
steps: Click Send message with empty fields
expected: Browser validation blocks submission and no conversation opens.

title: Send a new patient message to the care team
steps: Choose Care team and Medical Question
expected: Conversation shows the exact subject, patient sender and supplied body.

title: Physician replies to the correct patient conversation
expected: Patient sees the physician sender and acknowledgement once.

title: New-reply notification opens the matching conversation
expected: Notification destination opens the test conversation with the physician reply.

title: Mark all test-patient notifications read and persist
expected: Read labels remain and Unread labels disappear.

title: Empty conversation reply is blocked
expected: Required validation blocks the reply and message count stays unchanged.

title: Patient reply persists and the composer clears
expected: Reply appears once, composer is empty, and saved reply survives reload.

title: Cancel archiving without moving the conversation
expected: Conversation stays open with Archive available and Restore absent.

title: Archive a conversation with explicit list feedback
expected: Archive tab is selected, saved notice is specific, and conversation is listed.

title: Restore archived conversation with confirmation and inbox redirect
expected: Inbox is selected, exact restoration notice is visible, conversation remains in inbox after refresh.

title: Filter seeded laboratory results by test name
expected: Every displayed result matches the test name.

title: Filter laboratory results to their visible collection date
steps: Read a result date from the list
Set collection date range to that date
expected: Returned rows share the selected collection date.

title: Unmatched laboratory search shows an empty result
steps: Search a nonexistent synthetic test name
expected: No result links are displayed and an empty-state message appears.

title: Lab detail shows reference range and keyboard-readable history
steps: Inspect result and focus a historical data point
expected: Value/reference range are present and historical point focus reveals its measurement.

title: Download a laboratory PDF through the browser
steps: Click Download PDF on lab detail
expected: Download has .pdf extension and PDF file signature.

title: Clear an empty result search and recover laboratory results
steps: Clear the name and apply filters
expected: The empty-state message disappears and published result rows are restored.

title: Health summary identifies the patient and clinical sections
steps: Open Health Summary as seeded patient
Inspect demographics, allergies, and current medications
expected: Jordan Vale identity, allergy record, medication and correction form are visible.

title: Medication-name filter narrows current prescriptions
expected: Cetirizine remains and Vitamin D3 is not listed.

title: Physician creates a medication for the test patient
steps: Select test patient in staff workspace
expected: Medication drawer identifies Blair Test and the saved prescription.

title: Patient sees the newly created prescription details
expected: Strength, synthetic pharmacy, instructions and empty refill state match staff entry.

title: Cancel refill confirmation without submitting a request
expected: Refill list stays empty and Request refill remains available.

title: Submit a refill request and prevent duplicates while pending
expected: One Requested refill is shown; duplicate request button is hidden.

title: Physician approves refill and patient receives the decision
expected: Approved and the physician decision note appear on the patient page.

title: Complete refill and allow a future request
steps: Staff changes approved refill to Completed with note
expected: Completed and decision text are visible; a future refill can be requested again.

title: Medication correction request reaches staff and can be reviewed
steps: Patient submits a synthetic pharmacy correction
Staff opens Patient correction requests for Blair Test
expected: Staff sees exact correction text and review state persists.
